title: The Wardrobe of Room 214
author: Hazel Oyelaran
blurb: Mirabel Zhou, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
